from.place: ## Proof, acyclicity sentence: the generically vanishing sheaf is the filtered colimit of the kernels of the affine-open units.

title: Generic-vanishing sheaves are filtered colimits of affine-open kernels
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $C$ be an integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves]. Let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For each nonempty affine open $U\subset C$, let $j_U:U\to C$ be the inclusion, let $u_U:G\to j_{U*}j_U^{-1}G$ be the adjunction unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and put $K_U=\ker(u_U)$ [def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel]. Order the nonempty affine opens by reverse inclusion; this is a filtered poset since $C$ is irreducible. For nonempty affine opens $V\subseteq U$ the unit $u_V$ factors through $u_U$, so $K_U\subseteq K_V$, and these inclusions form a filtered diagram $(K_U)$. If every section of $G$ is, after an etale covering in $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], killed by some $u_U$ (with $U$ allowed to depend on the covering member), then the canonical morphism $\varinjlim_U K_U\to G$ is an isomorphism in the category of abelian etale sheaves on $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: ## Proof, acyclicity sentence; precise Lean construction in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Curve/GenericComparison.lean, lines 164-211

proof.text: Let I be the poset of nonempty affine opens of C, ordered by reverse inclusion. It is nonempty because C is a nonempty integral scheme, and for U,V in I the intersection U ∩ V contains the generic point; the affine-open basis [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] supplies a nonempty affine W ⊆ U ∩ V. Thus I is filtered. For V ⊆ U, naturality of the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction units gives a factorization u_V = (j_{U*}j_U^{-1}G → j_{V*}j_V^{-1}G) ∘ u_U, so the kernel inclusion K_U → K_V is defined by the universal property of kernels. These inclusions satisfy the identity and composition laws, hence form a filtered diagram of kernels.

source.place: ## Proof, acyclicity sentence: affine opens ordered by reverse inclusion and compatibility of the units; Lean GenericComparison.lean:164-181

proof.text: Let φ : colim_I K_U → G be the canonical map induced by the kernel inclusions. For every U there is a short exact sequence 0 → K_U → G → G/K_U → 0, where G/K_U is the cokernel of the kernel inclusion K_U → G (not of u_U), and the transition maps make these short exact sequences a diagram over I, with G the constant middle diagram. Exactness of filtered colimits in abelian sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaves-filtered-colimits-exact] shows that the induced map from colim_I K_U to colim_I G is monic. The colimit of the constant diagram is canonically G, and under this identification the induced map is φ; hence φ is monic.

source.place: ## Proof, acyclicity sentence: the colimit of kernels maps monomorphically to G; Lean GenericComparison.lean:171-186

proof.text: The assumed generic-vanishing condition says that for every section s of G over an etale object V, there is a covering {V_a → V} and, for each a, a nonempty affine U_a such that u_{U_a}(s|_{V_a}) = 0. By the sectionwise description of a kernel, s|_{V_a} is the image of a section of K_{U_a}; therefore every section of G is locally in the image of φ. The abelian-sheaf epi/local-surjectivity criterion [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective] implies that φ is an epimorphism.

source.place: ## Proof, acyclicity sentence: generic-vanishing covering hypothesis gives local surjectivity; Lean GenericComparison.lean:187-201

proof.text: The category of abelian sheaves is abelian, so a morphism that is both monic and epic is an isomorphism. Applying this to φ proves that the canonical morphism colim_U K_U → G is an isomorphism.

split_report.summary: Expanded the generic-vanishing kernel-colimit argument into four steps: filtered reverse-inclusion affine opens and kernel transitions, monicity from exact filtered colimits, local surjectivity from the generic-vanishing hypothesis, and the abelian mono-plus-epi conclusion. No new nodes were needed because the DAG already contains the affine-open basis, filtered-colimit exactness, and abelian-sheaf epi/local-surjectivity statements.
split_report.blueprint: The steps realize the acyclicity sentence of lem-sc-generic-cohomology-comparison: affine-open kernels form the filtered diagram, the canonical map is mono and locally surjective, and hence an isomorphism.
